headline: Bank of America warns customers against sharing banking passwords with AI assistants
summary: Bank of America told customers not to share their banking passwords with AI assistants or agents, saying they are responsible for any activity resulting from AI agent access. The warning reflects a broader trend of financial institutions restricting third-party AI agent access to accounts.
